logic_errors.issue: Evidence-path validation differs from data/schema.json. validateRating accepts research/.hidden.json, while the schema rejects it. Consequently, import and build can accept a dataset that fails schema validation.
logic_errors.fix: Use equivalent path rules in both validators and add a parity regression test.

logic_errors.issue: The contract incorrectly says supplemental matched ratings take priority and legacy ratings are only a fallback. core.js correctly selects the newest matched rating across both collections.
logic_errors.fix: Document the combined date-based selection rule, consistent with METHODOLOGY.md and the webpage.

initial.summary: Read-only review found two consistency defects. Verified preserved primary/related ratings, quotes, ABV/volume, active40/master67 and tier archives; supplemental totals and saved numerical evidence agree, including both unchanged Untappd records. No introduced score cherry-picking, platform averaging, count conflation, personal-data loss or privacy issue found. Six selected Node test files passed; generated application copies match. Schema execution was blocked by missing jsonschema. No build, edits, network access or Git changes performed.

afterFixes.summary: Both prior blockers are fixed. Runtime evidenceFile validation matches the schema regex; the parity regression covers research/.hidden.json and passes. Documentation matches core selectedCommunity: combined legacy and matched supplemental ratings, newest date first, sourceId tie-break. Source-total recalculation is accurately documented. Both targeted Node test files passed. Prior full-review findings reused; no edits, builds, schema tools, commits or pushes performed.
